name: @app-patterns/vault-sync
description: Automatic backup engine for Git-versioned document folders: private-index snapshots, per-checkout backup branches, push and remote verification, and a persistent protection deadline.

scripts.build:js: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/helper/index.ts ./src/helper/bin.ts ./src/helper/host.ts --root ./src --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages external
scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
